body.statement: The quantity \(\inf_{\ell\in\mathcal M_n}\mathcal E_n(\ell)\) is positive for all sufficiently large \(n\). Let \(m=m(n)\in\mathcal M_n\) satisfy the explicit asymptotic-minimax condition \[\frac{\mathcal E_n(m)}{\inf_{\ell\in\mathcal M_n}\mathcal E_n(\ell)}\to1.\] Then \[\frac{m}{\sqrt n}\to t^{\star},\qquad n^{3/2}\mathcal E_n(m)\to C^{\star}=\min_{t>0}\max_{\beta\in\mathcal K}\{A(\beta)t+B(\beta)/t\}.\] Here \(A\) is the full-array versus random-complement deletion coefficient and \(B\) is the continuous-coarea curvature coefficient induced by the common limit \(G_{\infty}\). The minimizer \(t^{\star}\) is unique, and \[C^{\star}=\max_{(a,b)\in\operatorname{conv}\{(A(\beta),B(\beta)):\beta\in\mathcal K\}}2\sqrt{ab}.\] An optimizer of the last display has a certificate supported on at most two parameter values active at \(t^{\star}\).
body.justification: The theorem turns the pointwise expansion into a unique globally defensible pilot rule with a finite certificate.
body.gap: Yamin's binary-arm global boundary analysis gives an approximately optimal \(n^{2/3}\) plan, whereas this locally rich factorial geometry requires a sharp square-root constant and a different empirical oracle.
body.consumer: Stable-batch replications of Menon, Chakrabarti, and Nerella's sequential factorial workflow can preregister the learning-wave size from a two-state worst-case certificate.

obligation.what_is_open: The statistical transfer from the interior risk expansion and endpoint exclusions to the global minimax pilot sequence.
obligation.obstruction: The deterministic optimization is proved, but its premises are the still-open uniform second-order risk theorem and endpoint lemma. Therefore positivity of the finite minimax denominator and convergence of every near-minimizing pilot sequence cannot yet be concluded.
obligation.attempted: Proved uniqueness, the convex-hull formula, and the two-active-state certificate, and checked the subsequence argument conditional on coercive endpoint exclusion. No unconditional route bypasses the missing statistical comparisons.
obligation.partial_result: The deterministic part is completely settled by \(\mathrm{lem{:}deterministic\text{-}envelope\text{-}certificate}\): for continuous positive \(A,B\), the envelope has a unique minimizer and the convex-hull value has a certificate supported on at most two active parameter values.  Conditional on the uniform interior risk expansion and endpoint exclusion, balanced rounding changes \(m/\sqrt n\) by \(O(n^{-1/2})\); coercivity makes every asymptotically minimax pilot ratio precompact, and continuity plus uniqueness forces every subsequential limit to equal \(t^{\star}\).  The statistical premises of that conditional transfer remain open.
